report:
# Task 40

add the status command's --json flag

---

## What I did

Added `keryx status --json`, building the document from the probes `status.py` already had names for: the restart store, the supervisor, the health check and the task counts. Each part reports its own `ok`/`error` so one broken probe never takes the rest of the page down with it, the same shape the approvals and doctor documents already use.

## Testing

Added `tests/test_status.py` with a fake set of probes, covering the migration-required path (the database is never opened), one probe raising an exception while the others still render, and the exact JSON shape against the sample in the plan. `uv run pytest -q` and `uv run ruff check src tests` are both clean.

## Notes

The service needs a restart to pick this up, since `cli.py` changed. Text mode still prints the same six lines as before; `--json` is additive.
